answer: Archival provenance chains anchor agent identity to a bonded ledger entry, so a reputation nadir after any dispute triggers mandatory re-staking before new work is accepted. Each agent climbs from that nadir toward a verified summit of trust only by publishing hash-linked attestations that peers co-sign, and no single ledge of the ledger can be rewritten without breaking every. Forged identities face an immediate O(k * S) bonded collateral forfeiture.
